name: CommoditySalesContractBook
tagline: Your whole grain marketing book in one app – sold, priced, delivered and due.
description: A plug-and-play Power Apps component for growers, merchandisers and co-ops: forward, spot, basis, HTA, minimum-price and pool sales contracts with pricing deadlines and mark-to-market, delivery fill against tolerance, the marketing-plan position (% sold vs production estimate) with over-commitment control, and settlement – in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Six contract types with futures / basis / floor components
Pricing deadlines, mark-to-market and price-target alerts
Marketing position per commodity with target and over-commitment markers
What-if sale that creates a draft contract
Delivery timeline with fill, tolerance and overdue tracking
Sign, deliver, price, close short, settle and cancel with business rules
Bulk sign, settle and assign marketer
Search, 16 quick filters, filters drawer, grouping, sorting, CSV export
Undo, notes history, read-only, custom labels / colours / currency
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field control)
